title: Spicy Pineapple Tartlets
description: A twist on traditional Thai desserts, these bite-sized tartlets combine the sweetness of pineapple with a hint of spiciness from the adventurous ingredient.
instructions: Roll out tart pastry and cut into small squares.
Place a small spoonful of pineapple onto one half of each square, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Fold the other half of the pastry square over the pineapple and press edges to seal.
Brush tops with coconut oil and sprinkle with adventurous spice blend.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until pastry is golden brown.
